name: E34 Lore
description: E34 Lore is an independent BMW E34 and E30 workshop reference and owner community. It connects interactive vehicle models, parts catalogs, repair guides, electrical references and member projects.
audience: BMW E34 and E30 owners, restorers and enthusiasts.
placements: Disclosed retailer links beside reviewed catalog matches and approved sponsor placements on eligible public pages.
